title: millettia piscatoria
intro: Millettia piscatoria, commonly known as fish poison tree, is a plant species in the legume family, known for its toxic properties. The health benefits of Millettia piscatoria include its potential anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal activities, which may aid in the treatment of various infections and diseases. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including rotenone and deguelin, which exhibit strong insecticidal and antitumor properties. However, further research is needed to fully understand the effects and potential uses of Millettia piscatoria, and it should be handled with caution due to its toxic properties.
